chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 429: Li Huowang's Desperate Battle Against the Supervisory Heavenly Office
chapter_meta_description: Skewered with the enemies he hates, Li Huowang must slaughter the Supervisory Heavenly Office agents who refuse to believe he's not a Zuowandao trickster.
og_title: Skewered and Pissed: Li Huowang vs. the World
og_description: He tore off his own face to prove it, but nobody believes he's not a trickster. So Li Huowang does the only thing he can: he kills everyone.
twitter_description: Imprisoned and mocked by his own enemies, Li Huowang uses his parasitic daughter to turn the tables in a brutal, one-man massacre.

lore_anchors.definition: Ancient Chinese divinatory symbols representing cosmic forces; used in Daoist rituals to create binding formations.

The sentient Black Tai Sui parasite living inside Li Huowang, whom he treats as his daughter.
